$comment: Shared table for the ADR-0014 §1.7 prop value rules, read by converters/oscal-to-hdf/go/vocabulary_test.go and converters/oscal-to-hdf/typescript/vocabulary.test.ts. 'in' is the HDF value; 'value' is the prop value the emit helper writes, or null when it writes no prop (an empty value is §1.7.3, decided by the caller); 'remarks' is the exact HDF value the prop carries when normalization changed it, or null. Normalization replaces each maximal run of CR, LF, U+2028 and U+2029 with one space, then trims ECMAScript \s whitespace; a value with nothing left becomes _. 'ecmascriptWhitespace' lists every code point ECMAScript \s matches (WhiteSpace plus LineTerminator); each language checks its trim set against it over the whole code-point range, which is what keeps Go from using strings.TrimSpace (it trims U+0085 and keeps U+FEFF) and pins the TypeScript regex to this Unicode version.

cases.name: a value OSCAL can hold is unchanged
interior spaces and tabs are kept
leading and trailing spaces are trimmed
LF becomes one space
CRLF is one run and becomes one space
a lone CR becomes one space
blank lines are one run
a space between line terminators ends the run
U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR becomes one space
U+2029 PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR becomes one space
mixed line terminators are one run
a trailing newline is removed
line terminators and spaces at both edges are removed
U+0085 NEXT LINE inside a value is kept: it is not an OSCAL line terminator
U+0085 NEXT LINE at the edges is kept: it is not ECMAScript whitespace
U+FEFF at the start is trimmed: it is ECMAScript whitespace
NBSP at the edges is trimmed
NBSP inside a value is kept
vertical tab and form feed at the edges are trimmed
every Unicode space separator at the edges is trimmed
U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE is not whitespace
U+180E MONGOLIAN VOWEL SEPARATOR is not whitespace
a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane is kept
a whitespace-only value becomes _
a value of line terminators only becomes _
a value of mixed whitespace only becomes _
a value that is already _ is unchanged
an empty value writes no prop
